name: punchwall-motion-feedback
description: Validate one bounded start-training presentation, exact scheduled Power without tick feedback spam, and real Punch/Reward, Shop, fixture-granted Pet, Rebirth and Boss feedback.

do
 local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player, world, storage)
  assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','fixture requires an ephemeral Studio world')
  assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'world allows live profile access')
  assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'ServerStorage opts into live data')
  assert(player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture requires a ready nonwritable ephemeral player')
  return true
 end
 assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'combat QA is Studio-only')
 local players=game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'combat QA requires exactly one isolated player')
 verifyEphemeralSeed(players[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game:GetService('ServerStorage'))
end
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local command = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("PunchWallAutomation", 5)
assert(command, "missing PunchWallAutomation")
return HttpService:JSONEncode(command:Invoke("Reset"))

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local G=require(RS.GameConfig) local station=G.TrainingStation('rookie_bag')
local function inspect(holder)
 local count,bounded,text=0,true,'' local a=holder.AbsolutePosition local z=a+holder.AbsoluteSize
 for _,d in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
  if d:IsA('GuiObject') and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and d.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 then
   count+=1 local l=d.AbsolutePosition local r=l+d.AbsoluteSize
   bounded=bounded and l.X>=a.X-2 and l.Y>=a.Y-2 and r.X<=z.X+2 and r.Y<=z.Y+2
   if d:IsA('TextLabel') then text=d.Text end
  end
 end
 return {count=count,bounded=bounded,text=text,sequence=holder:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0,mode=holder:GetAttribute('PresentationMode'),cap=holder:GetAttribute('MaxVisibleItems')}
end
local initial=inspect(gui.Toasts) assert(initial.count==0,'old feedback must expire before arming training probe')
local token=H:GenerateGUID(false) gui:SetAttribute('CombatQATrainToken',token)
local state={token=token,events={},powerBefore=p.leaderstats.Power.Value,feedbackBefore=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0,toastBefore=initial.sequence,rewardBefore=gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0,expectedTarget=station.displayName,rate=station.gain,captured=false}
local function save() if gui:GetAttribute('CombatQATrainToken')==token then gui:SetAttribute('CombatQATrainEvidence',H:JSONEncode(state)) end end
save()
local connection
connection=RS.PunchWallEvents.Feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
 if gui:GetAttribute('CombatQATrainToken')~=token then connection:Disconnect() return end
 if typeof(payload)~='table' then return end
 state.events[#state.events+1]={type=tostring(payload.type or ''),target=tostring(payload.target or ''),active=payload.active==true,stationId=tostring(payload.stationId or ''),gain=tonumber(payload.gain) or 0}
 task.defer(function()
  if gui:GetAttribute('CombatQATrainToken')~=token then return end
  if not state.captured then
   game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped:Wait()
   state.feedbackAfter=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0 state.toasts=inspect(gui.Toasts) state.rewards=inspect(gui.RewardPops)
   state.lastType=gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType') state.lastTarget=gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget') state.captured=true
  end
  save()
 end)
end)
task.delay(30,function() connection:Disconnect() end)
return H:JSONEncode({ready=true,token=token,expectedTarget=station.displayName,feedbackBefore=state.feedbackBefore})

local function verifyTrainingPayout(before, immediate, after, rate, tickSeconds)
 assert(immediate.Power==before.Power and immediate.payoutSerial==before.payoutSerial and immediate.sessionTickCount==0,'training paid before a scheduled tick')
 assert(immediate.sessionGeneration==before.sessionGeneration+1 and immediate.active and immediate.movementLocked,'training did not start one locked session')
 local ticks=after.sessionTickCount local delta=after.Power-before.Power
 assert(ticks>=1 and ticks<=2 and ticks==math.floor(ticks),'missing or excessive first scheduled tick batch')
 assert(after.payoutSerial==immediate.payoutSerial+1 and after.lastTickBatch==ticks,'duplicate or unaccounted payout batch')
 assert(delta==rate*ticks and after.lastGrant==delta and after.gainPerSecond==rate,'training rate differs from the server station configuration')
 assert(math.abs(after.tickAnchor-immediate.tickAnchor-ticks*tickSeconds)<1e-5,'payout did not consume exactly its scheduled intervals')
 assert(after.active and after.movementLocked,'training unlocked before its payout was observed')
 return true
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
p:SetAttribute('TrainingBoostExpiresAt',0) local station=G.TrainingStation('rookie_bag') local before=c:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') local r=c:Invoke('Train',station.name) local immediate=c:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot')
assert(r.ok and r.gain==0 and r.active,'start must activate without a free payout')
local after=immediate local deadline=os.clock()+2.6 repeat task.wait(.04) after=c:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') until after.payoutSerial>immediate.payoutSerial or os.clock()>=deadline
local exactPayout=verifyTrainingPayout(before,immediate,after,station.gain,G.Training.TickSeconds)
return H:JSONEncode({ok=r.ok,active=after.active,TrainingActive=after.TrainingActive,gain=r.gain,Power=after.Power,exactPayout=exactPayout,ticks=after.sessionTickCount})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local function verifyTrainingFeedback(e)
 assert(e.captured and #e.events==1,'training start must present exactly one feedback event')
 local event=e.events[1]
 assert(event.type=='TrainingState' and event.target==e.expectedTarget and event.active==true and event.stationId=='rookie_bag' and event.gain==e.rate,'wrong start training payload')
 assert(e.feedbackAfter-e.feedbackBefore==1 and e.lastType=='TrainingState' and e.lastTarget==e.expectedTarget,'start feedback counter or displayed identity drifted')
 assert(e.toasts.mode=='BoundedVisibleQueueV1' and e.toasts.cap==3 and e.toasts.count==1 and e.toasts.bounded and e.toasts.sequence==e.toastBefore+1 and e.toasts.text==e.expectedTarget,'start toast is duplicated, hidden, unbounded or wrong')
 assert(e.rewards.mode=='BoundedVisibleQueueV1' and e.rewards.cap==3 and e.rewards.bounded and e.rewards.sequence==e.rewardBefore,'training leaked a center reward presentation')
 return true
end
local raw=gui:GetAttribute('CombatQATrainEvidence') assert(type(raw)=='string','missing serialized training probe') local evidence=H:JSONDecode(raw)
assert(gui:GetAttribute('CombatQATrainToken')==evidence.token,'stale training probe')
local presentation=verifyTrainingFeedback(evidence)
local ticks=p:GetAttribute('TrainingSessionTickCount') or 0 local delta=p.leaderstats.Power.Value-evidence.powerBefore
local exactPower=ticks>=1 and delta==ticks*evidence.rate
local noTickFeedback=(gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)==evidence.feedbackAfter and #evidence.events==1 and (gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)==evidence.toastBefore+1 and (gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)==evidence.rewardBefore
local state=p.RPGStats.TrainingActive.Value==1 and p:GetAttribute('AutoTrainingActive')==true and p:GetAttribute('TrainingMovementLocked')==true and gui:GetAttribute('ContinuousTrainingAnimation')==true
local valid=presentation and exactPower and noTickFeedback and state
assert(valid,'training presentation, exact replicated payout, or quiet continuous tick failed '..H:JSONEncode({evidence=evidence,ticks=ticks,delta=delta,noTickFeedback=noTickFeedback,state=state}))
gui:SetAttribute('CombatQATrainToken','')
return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid,eventCount=#evidence.events,firstType=evidence.events[1].type,firstTarget=evidence.events[1].target,countDelta=evidence.feedbackAfter-evidence.feedbackBefore,toastBounded=evidence.toasts.bounded,rewardBounded=evidence.rewards.bounded,rewardSequenceDelta=evidence.rewards.sequence-evidence.rewardBefore,exactPower=exactPower,noTickFeedback=noTickFeedback,state=state,power=p.leaderstats.Power.Value,ticks=ticks})

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local command = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("PunchWallAutomation")
local player = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
assert(player, "missing test player")
command:Invoke("Reset")
command:Invoke("SetStats", { Power = 120, Coins = 0, WallLevel = 1, CritChance = 0, FistMultiplier = 1, PetMultiplier = 0 })
player:SetAttribute("CoinBoostExpiresAt", 0)
local root = workspace:WaitForChild("PunchWallRPG")
local block = root:WaitForChild("Depth Blocks"):WaitForChild("DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02")
local blockCoinReward = tonumber(block:GetAttribute("CoinReward")) or 0
local expectedCoins = GameConfig.ContributionReward(blockCoinReward, 1)
local beforeCoins = player.leaderstats.Coins.Value
local result = command:Invoke("BreakWall", "Brick Wall", 1)
local resultingCoins = tonumber(result and result.Coins) or -1
local outcome = tostring(result and result.outcome or "")
local aliasIsCurrent = block:GetAttribute("IsDepthBlock") == true and block:GetAttribute("Tier") == 1 and block:GetAttribute("Depth") == 1
local boostCleared = (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CoinBoostExpiresAt")) or -1) == 0 and tonumber(result and result.CoinBoostExpiresAt) == 0
local expectedPositive = blockCoinReward > 0 and expectedCoins > 0
local exactReward = beforeCoins == 0 and resultingCoins == expectedCoins and player.leaderstats.Coins.Value == expectedCoins
local rewardValid = result ~= nil and result.ok == true and aliasIsCurrent and boostCleared and expectedPositive and result.BrickWallBroken == true and outcome == "broken" and exactReward
return HttpService:JSONEncode({ ok = result and result.ok == true, alias = block.Name, blockCoinReward = blockCoinReward, expectedCoins = expectedCoins, coins = resultingCoins, boostCleared = boostCleared, expectedPositive = expectedPositive, exactReward = exactReward, BrickWallBroken = result and result.BrickWallBroken == true, outcome = outcome, rewardValid = rewardValid })

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local gui=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer:WaitForChild('PlayerGui'):WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local probe=shared.PunchWallRewardFeedbackProbe
assert(probe,'missing punch reward feedback probe')
if probe.connection then probe.connection:Disconnect() probe.connection=nil end
shared.PunchWallRewardFeedbackProbe=nil
local punchIndex,rewardIndex
for index,event in ipairs(probe.events) do
 if not punchIndex and event.type=='Punch' and event.target==probe.alias then punchIndex=index end
 if not rewardIndex and event.type=='Reward' and event.target==probe.alias then rewardIndex=index end
end
local rewardEvent=rewardIndex and probe.events[rewardIndex] or nil
local ordered=punchIndex~=nil and rewardIndex~=nil and punchIndex<rewardIndex
local rewardExact=rewardEvent~=nil and rewardEvent.wallBreak==true and rewardEvent.coins==probe.expectedCoins
local feedbackDelta=(gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)-probe.feedbackBefore
local feedbackCovers=feedbackDelta>=#probe.events and #probe.events>=2
local lastBurst=tonumber(gui:GetAttribute('LastCoinBurstCount')) or 0
local burstDelta=(tonumber(gui:GetAttribute('CoinBurstTotal')) or 0)-probe.coinBurstBefore
local burstValid=lastBurst>=1 and lastBurst<=7 and burstDelta>=lastBurst
local coinFolder=workspace:FindFirstChild('Local Coin Rewards')
local liveCoins=coinFolder and #coinFolder:GetChildren() or -1
local liveBounded=coinFolder~=nil and liveCoins>=0 and liveCoins<=30
local normalMotion=gui:GetAttribute('LastMotionApplied')==true and gui:GetAttribute('ReducedMotionCoinTravelSuppressed')==false
local centerDisabled=gui:GetAttribute('CenterActionFeedbackEnabled')==false
local rewardSequenceDelta=(gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)-probe.rewardSequenceBefore
local noCenterReward=rewardSequenceDelta==0
local valid=ordered and rewardExact and feedbackCovers and burstValid and liveBounded and normalMotion and centerDisabled and noCenterReward
return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid,normalMotion=normalMotion,ordered=ordered,eventCount=#probe.events,punchIndex=punchIndex or 0,rewardIndex=rewardIndex or 0,alias=probe.alias,expectedCoins=probe.expectedCoins,rewardCoins=rewardEvent and rewardEvent.coins or -1,rewardWallBreak=rewardEvent and rewardEvent.wallBreak==true or false,rewardExact=rewardExact,feedbackDelta=feedbackDelta,feedbackCovers=feedbackCovers,lastBurst=lastBurst,burstDelta=burstDelta,burstValid=burstValid,liveCoins=liveCoins,liveBounded=liveBounded,centerDisabled=centerDisabled,rewardSequenceDelta=rewardSequenceDelta,noCenterReward=noCenterReward,terminalType=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType') or ''),terminalTarget=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget') or '')})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local player=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
local gui=player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui'):WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local GameConfig=require(RS:WaitForChild('GameConfig'))
local feedbackType=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType') or '')
local target=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget') or '')
local baseName,stars=GameConfig.ParsePetToken(target)
local definition=GameConfig.PetDefinition(baseName)
local catalogIndex=0
for index,pet in ipairs(GameConfig.Pets) do
 if pet.name==baseName then catalogIndex=index break end
end
local premium=false
for _,pet in ipairs(GameConfig.PremiumPets) do
 if pet.name==baseName then premium=true break end
end
local canonical=GameConfig.PetToken(baseName,stars)==target
local starsValid=stars==1 and stars>=1 and stars<=GameConfig.MaxPetStars
local inventoryValue=player:WaitForChild('RPGStats'):WaitForChild('PetInventoryJSON').Value
local decoded,inventory=pcall(function() return H:JSONDecode(inventoryValue) end)
if not decoded or type(inventory)~='table' then inventory={} end
local inventoryContains=table.find(inventory,target)~=nil
local petValid=feedbackType=='Pet' and definition~=nil and catalogIndex>0 and not premium and starsValid and canonical and inventoryContains
return H:JSONEncode({petValid=petValid,type=feedbackType,target=target,baseName=baseName,stars=stars,starsValid=starsValid,canonical=canonical,definitionExists=definition~=nil,hatchCatalog=catalogIndex>0,catalogIndex=catalogIndex,premium=premium,rarity=definition and definition.rarity or '',inventoryContains=inventoryContains,inventoryCount=#inventory,count=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0})
